text: Despite the rising relevance of investment due diligence and increasing due diligence litigation, the private fund industry is largely left to its own devices to ensure adequate due diligence standards.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016 (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2998097

isBasedOn.name: Private Investment Fund Regulation - Theory and Empirical Evidence from 1998 to 2016

abstract: Despite the increasing relevance of investment due diligence in the capital formation and allocation process and despite increasing litigation in the context of investment due diligence, the industry is mostly left to its own devices to ensure adequate due diligence standards apply.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: United States, since the 2008 to 2009 financial crisis
